hero.text: Where color theory meets classical art. Professional makeup artistry is more than applying color — it's understanding shape, light, shadow, and the principles that have guided artists for centuries. Every brushstroke is guided by knowledge and intention.

about.name: Ana Jaksic
about.intro: Award-winning global makeup artist, certified MUD educator, and CEO of MUD Studio Vienna — with over 25 years of professional experience. Ana brings a rare combination of classical artistry, scientific precision, and creative vision to every project.
about.career: Her career has taken her across the world — from 8 years as part of the artist training & development team across Scandinavia (Denmark, Sweden, Norway & Iceland), to the IFFA Awards in Macao, the Eurovision Song Contest, and fashion weeks in Milan, Paris, and London. She is a passionate advocate for empowering women through beauty and education worldwide.
about.specialties: Editorial, Bridal, Fashion, Artistic Makeup & Education
about.awards: Best Make-Up Artist — Vienna Awards 2025 · Women of the Year — Look! Magazine
about.educationText: Certified MUD Educator — CEO & Lead Educator at MUD Studio Vienna
about.storyP1: I'm Ana Jaksic — a global makeup artist, certified educator, and passionate advocate for the art and science behind professional beauty. Based in Vienna, my work spans editorial, bridal, and artistic makeup.
about.storyP2: Professional makeup artistry is far more than applying color to a face. Without analyzing facial shapes, understanding corrective theory, knowing how light and shadow transform and behave on the face — makeup remains guesswork. It is a discipline rooted in the same principles we know from classical paintings and centuries of color theory.
about.storyP3: Every face is a canvas. Every decision — from color to placement — must be intentional, informed, and deeply personal.
